name: goodsender
description: Publish blog posts, send newsletters and emails from Claude, Claude Code, Codex and ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
GoodSender connects your assistant to your GoodSender blog, newsletter and email sending, so you can write and ship from the conversation.

Blog: draft posts in Markdown, get a private preview link, choose where a post goes (your blog, the newsletter, connected social accounts), then publish. Edit or delete posts, upload images, manage blog settings, connect a custom domain and create or switch blog designs.

Newsletter: email a published post to subscribers who opted in, and send yourself a test copy first.

Email: send consent-based custom emails and saved templates to recipients and groups. Recipients you add get a consent request. Mail to anyone who hasn't consented waits until they do. Built-in transactional templates (one-time codes, password and email changes, order receipts) send right away from your verified domain. Check sender-domain health and consent counts.

Every tool is marked read-only or not. Publishing, sending, deleting and live-site changes are marked destructive, so your assistant asks you before running them. Sign-in uses OAuth with your GoodSender account. The connector acts only inside the workspace you approve. A GoodSender account with a blog is required. Sending email also needs a verified sender domain.
capabilities: Draft, preview and publish blog posts
Email a published post to newsletter subscribers
Manage recipients, groups, sender identities and templates
Manage blog settings, designs and a custom domain
defaultPrompt: List my blog posts and show which are drafts.
Draft a post from these notes and show me a preview before publishing.
Email my latest post to newsletter subscribers.

review.commerce_description: GoodSender does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.
